analysis.dynamic_system: bullish regime with strong upward momentum; graph_score 1.0, confidence 0.75; top drivers include market watch, options, intermarket model; risk drivers include regime classification and rotation score; uncertainty high due to missing real-time Iranian market data and option chain data.
analysis.political_economy: high geopolitical risk from sanctions and Hormuz tensions, but strong commodity demand and price sensitivity support bullish regime for commodity-linked equities; fiscal and energy stress present but offset by growth metrics.
analysis.market_implications: Sector rotation favors metals_mining, energy_sector, commodity_traders; losers include import_depending_sectors, currency_hedge_strategies, domestic_demand_stocks; valuation impact shows multiple expansion for growth stocks, sector premium for commodity-related stocks, rial weakness boosts exporters; risk environment includes commodity_price_volatility, currency_risk, geopolitical_tensions; hedging_opportunities: commodity_derivatives, currency_futures, geopolitical_insurance.
analysis.option_implications: Option chain data missing; rely on structure, liquidity and OI; avoid buying high-IV calls based solely on copper bullishness; use delta, IV, theta, open interest and spread liquidity; confirm spot direction before buying options.
